description:
## Functional specifications
Update architecture and Agent/Engine/Channels service owners with canonical storage, strategy ownership, grants, cursor semantics, cutover and downstream prerequisites. Run migration/data-preservation checks, isolated suites and mix q per issue. Review reuse, private-data boundaries and all access consumers. Then human UI approval, consolidated E2E, required coverage handoff/review and final mix precommit with a 900-second timeout. Report unresolved blockers rather than closing the epic prematurely. Commit/push only when separately authorized.

## Files and ownership
docs/architecture.md; docs/services/{agent,engine,channels}.md; relevant guides and issue validation suites

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable for docs-only work; integration review must confirm every implemented operation uses recorded shared boundary. This is pre-UX integrated verification, not the final precommit gate.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
Owner docs only; preserve legacy descriptions as historical where appropriate

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.11] Integrated architecture documentation and validation
